description: `LIMIT n OFFSET m`: simple and allows page jumps, but slow on deep pages and items shift when rows are inserted or deleted.
The client sends an opaque cursor for the last item; the server queries `WHERE key > cursor`. Fast at any depth and stable under writes.
A token clients pass back unchanged (often base64 JSON). Its contents can change without breaking clients; it must still be validated.
A unique column (`id`) added to every sort so equal values always come out in the same order and pages never overlap.
Only known field names are accepted for sorting and filtering. Prevents `ORDER BY` injection and slow scans on unindexed columns.
An object around the items (`{ items, total }` or `{ items, nextCursor }`) so metadata can grow without breaking clients.
